title: Notification center
missing: No durable inbox, unread badge or history contract.
recommendation: Add notification and user_notification entities plus list/unread/read APIs.
tests: Create/read/mark-all, pagination, multi-device sync, tenant isolation

title: Trigger ownership
missing: Schedule rule says notify but does not define who is notified.
recommendation: Map every trigger to owner, watchers, Admin/Operator roles and opt-out policy.
tests: Owner changed, role removed, multiple watchers, no eligible recipient

title: Deduplication
missing: Duplicate domain/provider events can create duplicate alerts.
recommendation: Unique source_event_id + user_id; group noisy repeated events.

title: Preferences
missing: No event-category/channel preference model.
recommendation: Define mandatory vs optional categories and per-user preferences.
tests: Muted optional, mandatory critical, default preference migration

title: Action lifecycle
missing: Read state cannot represent resolved/expired action.
recommendation: Separate unread from open/resolved/expired and define action deadlines.
tests: Read but unresolved, auto-resolve after campaign recovery

title: Localization
missing: Rendered message text would be hard to re-localize.
recommendation: Persist message_key and parameters; render safely in UI.
tests: Locale switch, missing translation, unsafe parameter

title: Event envelope
missing: No common schema/version/cursor is defined.
recommendation: Define event_id, type, schema_version, occurred_at, channel, resource, payload and sequence.
tests: Schema validation, unknown version, duplicate event

title: Reconnect and gap recovery
missing: No behavior after connection loss.
recommendation: Client resumes by cursor; server can emit resync_required; REST refetch remains authoritative.

title: Socket authorization
missing: Channel membership and tenant isolation are not specified.
recommendation: Authenticate handshake and authorize every room join; evict on role/session changes.
tests: Cross-tenant room, expired session, revoked role

title: Event volume policy
missing: Per-recipient progress could overload gateway and UI.
recommendation: Publish aggregate progress <=1/s or per 250 recipients; details remain queryable.
tests: 100k campaign event rate and browser CPU

title: Horizontal scaling
missing: Single-instance websocket behavior is insufficient.
recommendation: Use Socket.IO Redis adapter and sticky-session/load-balancer validation where required.
tests: Two gateway replicas, reconnect during rolling deploy

title: Backpressure
missing: Slow/disconnected clients are undefined.
recommendation: Bound buffers, drop superseded progress events and force resync rather than unbounded queueing.

title: User administration
missing: Only three roles are named; invite/disable/remove flows are absent.
recommendation: Add invite, accept, resend, expire, disable, remove and session revocation rules.
tests: Invite lifecycle, disabled user, last admin

title: Custom permissions
missing: Fixed roles may not cover sender/template/audience separation.
recommendation: Define permission matrix now; keep custom roles as P1 if not MVP.

title: Ownership
missing: Campaign/template/list ownership and reassignment are absent.
recommendation: Store owner_id and define reassignment when user is disabled.

title: Tenant bootstrap
missing: Creation/default settings/first admin are undefined.
recommendation: Define organization provisioning, default timezone, retention and quotas.

title: Session inventory
missing: User cannot see/revoke active sessions.
recommendation: Add device/session list and revoke-all-except-current.

title: MFA/SSO roadmap
missing: Enterprise authentication requirements are not decided.
recommendation: Record MFA as P1 and OIDC/SAML as future ADR; do not bake local auth assumptions into domain.

title: Approval workflow
missing: An Operator can potentially schedule large campaigns without approval.
recommendation: Optional approval policy by audience size/sender; states draft/in_review/approved/rejected.
tests: Self-approval forbidden, approval invalidated by edit

title: Optimistic concurrency UI
missing: Draft concurrency rule lacks conflict resolution UX.
recommendation: Use version/ETag, show conflict diff and preserve local changes.

title: Comments/mentions
missing: No review discussion attached to campaign/template.
recommendation: Add comments/mentions only if approval is enabled; mentions create notifications.

title: Change summary
missing: Reviewer cannot see what changed since approval request.
recommendation: Store draft revision metadata and render field-level summary.

title: Clone campaign
missing: No reusable copy flow for a past campaign.
recommendation: Clone content/settings into new draft without copying historical snapshot or stats.

title: Archive/delete draft
missing: Lifecycle after abandonment is unclear.
recommendation: Allow archive/soft-delete draft; sent campaigns remain immutable.

title: Resend strategy
missing: Resend to failed/non-openers is undefined and can duplicate recipients.
recommendation: Create a new child campaign with explicit audience derivation and suppression checks.
tests: Resend failed only, unsubscribed since original

title: Preflight checklist
missing: Review lacks sender/domain/quota/link/content checks.
recommendation: Create server-side preflight result with blocking errors and warnings.
tests: Expired sender, quota, broken URL, missing text

title: Test-send safety
missing: Test email destination policy is only partially defined.
recommendation: Restrict domains/allowlist as configured; watermark and exclude from analytics.

title: Cancellation semantics
missing: Cancel does not define in-flight provider submissions.
recommendation: Stop enqueueing new messages; mark already accepted messages as non-recallable; show cutoff counts.

title: Pause reason
missing: Pause/resume has no reason/authorization/audit contract.
recommendation: Require reason for manual pause and record automatic pause threshold.
tests: Auto pause, manual resume without permission

title: Priority/fairness
missing: Multiple tenants/campaigns can starve the queue.
recommendation: Define per-tenant concurrency, campaign priority and fair scheduling.

title: Audience estimate expiry
missing: Preview may become stale before confirmation.
recommendation: Attach audience_hash, generated_at and expiry; revalidate on confirm.
tests: Segment changes between preview and confirm

title: Large missing-data repair
missing: Bulk custom-data update exists but no campaign-linked repair workflow.
recommendation: From missing-variable report, launch scoped bulk update and rerun validation.

title: Default-value governance
missing: Defaults can hide poor data quality.
recommendation: Show how many recipients use default; allow policy threshold/block.

title: Variable formatting
missing: Date/number/enum formatting per locale is not defined.
recommendation: Add safe formatter metadata to schema, not arbitrary template code.

title: Custom-field schema evolution
missing: Deleting/renaming a field used by template can break future sends.
recommendation: Dependency check and deprecation state; block delete while referenced.
tests: Delete referenced field and archived template

title: Selection token TTL
missing: Bulk scope snapshot token lifetime is not specified.
recommendation: Signed selection token with tenant/user/query hash, TTL and one-time confirmation semantics.

title: Encoding/delimiter
missing: CSV encoding, BOM and delimiter detection are absent.
recommendation: Support UTF-8/BOM, configurable delimiter and explicit error for unsupported encoding.

title: Formula/zip bomb safety
missing: XLSX parser security limits are not defined.
recommendation: Limit uncompressed size, sheets, cells and formulas; never execute formulas/macros.
tests: Zip bomb, macro file, external link

title: Dry-run persistence
missing: Mapping/preview cannot be reused or audited.
recommendation: Persist import draft, mapping and file fingerprint until expiration.

title: Export privacy
missing: Exports lack role/field masking/expiry rules.
recommendation: Authorize fields, audit download, signed short-lived URL and retention deletion.
tests: Viewer export, expired link, deleted job

title: Editor decision
missing: No supported visual editor and canonical storage format are selected.
recommendation: Spike GrapesJS; store canonical sanitized HTML/text plus optional editor JSON.

title: Content lint
missing: No broken link/image, size or accessibility checks.
recommendation: Add preflight lint with severity and actionable locations.
tests: Bad URL, missing alt, oversized HTML

title: Asset lifecycle
missing: Replacing/deleting images used by published versions is undefined.
recommendation: Immutable asset versions or reference-aware deletion; signed upload and malware scan.

title: Undo/version compare
missing: Template version exists but visual diff/restore is absent.
recommendation: Compare metadata/content and clone an old version into a new draft.
tests: Restore does not mutate old version

title: Domain authentication
missing: Only sender verification is defined; SPF/DKIM/DMARC status is absent.
recommendation: Model sending domain and verification checks; surface stale/missing records.
tests: DNS pending, DKIM rotated, DMARC warning

title: Bounce classification
missing: Bounced is a single state without hard/soft policy.
recommendation: Normalize hard/soft/complaint; thresholds and suppression updates differ.
tests: Soft retry exhaustion, hard bounce immediate suppression

title: Complaint handling
missing: Spam complaint flow is absent.
recommendation: Verify provider event, suppress immediately and notify responsible users.

title: Provider failover
missing: Adapter exists but failover policy is undefined.
recommendation: Do not automatic-failover in MVP unless idempotent provider IDs are proven; define manual switch runbook.

title: Credential rotation
missing: Secret rotation and expiry warnings are not defined.
recommendation: Version secret references, test before activate, revoke old after grace period.

title: Suppression reasons
missing: Suppression source/expiry/manual override are incomplete.
recommendation: Canonical suppression table with reason, source, effective_at, optional expiry and audit.

title: Link tracking policy
missing: Open/click tracking and privacy implications are undefined.
recommendation: Explicit tenant/campaign policy; signed redirect; bot filtering; allow disable.
tests: Tracking off, bot click, unsafe redirect

title: Unsubscribe endpoint
missing: URL exists but token, landing page and race behavior are not defined.
recommendation: Signed opaque token, idempotent action, immediate suppression and preference confirmation page.

title: Edit/reschedule boundary
missing: Lock timing around due execution is not explicit.
recommendation: Define minimum lead and atomic compare-and-swap between reschedule/cancel/dispatch.
tests: Cancel at due time across replicas

title: Maintenance delay
missing: Planned downtime behavior is absent.
recommendation: Define grace window, delayed notification and operator runbook.

title: Recurring campaigns
missing: Not explicitly in or out of scope.
recommendation: Mark out of MVP; future design must create immutable child campaigns per occurrence.

title: Metric definitions
missing: Sent/delivered/open/click/bounce denominators are not standardized.
recommendation: Publish metric dictionary including late webhooks and bot filtering.

title: Eventual correction
missing: Late delivery events can change completed campaign totals without UX rules.
recommendation: Show last_updated and provisional/final status; recompute idempotently.

title: Per-recipient privacy
missing: Drill-down access/masking/export is not role-specific.
recommendation: Field-level permission and masked email for Viewer where required.

title: Comparison
missing: No campaign comparison or trend baseline.
recommendation: Defer comparison to P1; define same metric dictionary first.

title: Provider reconciliation
missing: Counts can diverge without scheduled reconciliation workflow.
recommendation: Periodic job compares canonical messages/provider events and raises issue.

title: Audit retention/access
missing: Audit exists but retention, export and privileged access are not defined.
recommendation: Immutable append model, retention policy and dedicated audit permission.

title: Data-subject request
missing: Recipient export/delete workflow for privacy request is absent.
recommendation: Search identity, export, redact/delete subject to legal retention and record fulfillment.

title: Secret handling
missing: Provider secret storage and redaction details are incomplete.
recommendation: Secret manager references only; never return secret; log/trace redaction tests.

title: CSRF/CORS/CSP
missing: Browser security headers/policies are not specified.
recommendation: SameSite cookies, CSRF protection where needed, strict CORS and CSP compatible with editor assets.

title: Rate-limit dimensions
missing: Only login and provider limits are described.
recommendation: Per-IP/user/tenant limits for auth, preview, export, socket connect and expensive filters.

title: Dependency governance
missing: No SBOM/license/vulnerability policy.
recommendation: Lockfile, Renovate, SBOM, SCA and high-severity release gate.

title: Admin job console
missing: Operators cannot inspect/retry failed background jobs safely.
recommendation: Read-only queue/job view plus permissioned retry/cancel using domain commands.

title: Dead-letter workflow
missing: DLQ is tested but ownership and replay approval are absent.
recommendation: Alert, triage reason, safe replay tool and audit trail.

title: Feature flags
missing: Risky capabilities lack staged rollout/kill switch.
recommendation: Server-evaluated flags for send, schedule, editor and provider; audit changes.

title: Health/readiness
missing: Availability rule lacks dependency-specific health behavior.
recommendation: Liveness independent; readiness checks DB/Redis and worker queue lag thresholds.
tests: Redis down, DB slow, rolling deploy

title: Capacity limits
missing: File, audience and campaign limits are scattered/default-only.
recommendation: Central tenant plan/limit service and clear 409/422 errors with upgrade/contact path.

title: Offline/stale indicator
missing: Realtime connection state is invisible.
recommendation: Show live/reconnecting/stale state and last update; allow manual refresh.

title: Long-job navigation
missing: Leaving the page can hide import/bulk/send outcomes.
recommendation: Persist job links in notification center and global activity panel.

title: Error taxonomy
missing: UI cannot consistently distinguish validation/conflict/permission/retryable failures.
recommendation: Adopt standard problem-details schema with code, field errors, correlation_id and retryability.

title: Accessibility of live updates
missing: Progress/toast changes may not be announced correctly.
recommendation: Use appropriate aria-live politeness, prevent focus theft and provide text progress.
